comments.subject: Public Comments Form
comments.comment:
Dear Mayor and City Council Members,

I have been in contact with with several Departments, (City Planning, Parks & Recreation, and the Grounds Keeper of the golf course etc.) and my concerns are not being addressed.

Our association borders Southgate Golf Course, the 10th fairway to the East. For years there has always been a fence running North & South. Last year the fence has fallen over onto our property. We have asked that the fence be repaired or replaced. Nothing has been done as of this letter.

We are concerned that the property values are being reduced due to this situation. We are asking for your assistance in this matter.

Ron Smith

comments.subject: Public Comments Form
comments.comment:
I am writing to make ANOTHER complaint about the dog named Max that lives 24/7 in a kennel in the back of this guy's motor home. The address is [redacted]

This has gone on long enough. Who do we contact that will DO SOMETHING? This one year old dog, a beautiful German Shepard puppy, should be able to run and play and be socialized with people. He's a working dog, NOT A POSSESSION TO LOCK UP 24/7. I drive by every day and whistle. Sometimes he doesn't even get up to look, but other days he sticks his nose out of the bars and tries to see who might be coming to see him. This dog's spirit is broken and if he's going to have any chance at all, he needs to be taken out of this cage. I've seen the owner, Jeff, hit the dog if he barks and yell "I said no barking!" I saw his friend kick the dog and Max yelped.

These are some of the pictures we've taken. We have many more, taken day after day. He has been in this kennel for a couple of months, but before that he was in a cage that was approximately 4 ft by 4 ft. hardly enough room for a growing GSD. Are you going to do anything? Or is this just "a dog", so not important? Please tell me how I can help Max, if you can't or won't.

I believe that Jeff leaves, sometimes days on end, while Max is left in the kennel. His water is dirty, he never has food in his dish and I believe he's very skinny. This is animal cruelty and abuse. Also, the good people in the neighborhood have made an attempt to take Max biscuits, treats, toys and blankets, but NOW the owner has draped a black tarp around the outside of the kennel, making it even hotter and the dog can't see out at all, he has NO stimulation, visual or otherwise. The side that is open will get the hot afternoon sun and Max will bake. WHY do people like this get dogs and HOW do we allow this to continue. Is there no compassion left in the world? I know laws need to be changed, but if nobody will step out of their comfort zone and go against the grain and insist on change, then the abuse continues and innocent dogs suffer.

PLEASE JOIN OUR FIGHT TO SAVE MAX.

notes: Two JotForm submissions: Ron Smith (Southgate Golf Course fence; 5 attached photos not included due to size, per page 2 notice) and LeAnn Walters (Max the dog, Apr 21 - an earlier/separate submission from the Apr 28 one in the Apr25-May2 window; both kept per one-row-per-submission rule). max.jpg shown on page 4.
